title: New in-app assistant and continuous event playback
body:
- Added an in-app assistant that can answer questions about your cameras and events, using either a remote server or a model that runs on your device.
- The assistant shows a suggested question to get started and a status dot indicating whether its server is reachable.
- The assistant understands everyday time phrases like "yesterday afternoon" and shows times in your chosen time format.
- The assistant answers its first question faster and no longer shows raw tool text in the chat.
- Events can now play back continuously, moving on to the next event automatically.
- Fixed the event player looping the same event after continuous playback.
- Fixed a connection error when validating against ZoneMinder 1.38.3.
- Fixed on-device assistant model downloads being lost before they finished installing.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/ZoneMinder/zmNinjaNg/releases/tag/zmNinjaNg-2.0.0)

title: zmNinjaNg 1.4.0: new views, settings, and fixes
body:
- The monitor card badge now counts events since you last looked instead of always the last 7 days.
- The Events view can now show relative times such as "5 minutes ago".
- Added a per-profile setting to turn on STUN servers for WebRTC streaming.
- The startup dialog is now labeled "Connecting to server" instead of "Finishing setup".
- Fixed event images that could fail to load because the wrong event ID was sent in image requests.
- Keyboard shortcuts now work on desktop even when TV mode is on.
- Fixed the montage showing the wrong number of columns for some layouts, such as 5 or 9 columns.
- Fixed connecting to servers with self-signed certificates on iOS.
- Returning from an event no longer scrolls the events list back to the top.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/ZoneMinder/zmNinjaNg/releases/tag/zmNinjaNg-1.4.0)

title: Recent events, notice management, smoother scrubbing
body:
- Added a list of recent events to the monitor detail view
- Developer notices can now be deleted one at a time, cleared all at once, or restored
- Fixed inconsistent scrubbing when playing back an event

[Full changelog](https://github.com/ZoneMinder/zmNinjaNg/releases/tag/zmNinjaNg-1.3.0)

title: What's new in zmNinjaNg 1.2.0
body:
- Events view can now show relative times, like "5 minutes ago".
- Inactive zones on a monitor now look different from active ones.
- A command palette lets you jump to any screen quickly. Open it with the / key, the sidebar, or on mobile.
- Keyboard shortcuts can move you between screens.
- The language and menu buttons have been moved to more predictable spots.
- The desktop app now remembers its window position and size between launches.
- You can filter events to show only archived ones, and mark events as archived.
- Favorite events now keep loading past the "Load More" point.
- Switching monitors while watching a live stream now reliably shows the new stream.
- Returning from an event with the back gesture or button now keeps your place in the events list instead of jumping to the top.
- Clearing a time filter no longer also clears the monitor you were viewing.
- Event filtering now works consistently.
- Monitor filtering in the Monitors view works again.
- On Android, the back gesture now exits the app from the main screen instead of getting stuck.
- Panning around a monitor view has been improved.
- Zooming in on a monitor now enlarges the view.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/ZoneMinder/zmNinjaNg/releases/tag/zmNinjaNg-1.2.0)

title: Desktop app 1.1.14: switched from Tauri to Electron
body:
The 1.1.14 desktop builds (Linux, macOS, Windows) moved from Tauri to Electron. Tauri's WebKit backend had memory leaks I couldn't work around. They slowly drained RAM until live streams stopped working.

**Action needed**: your existing server profiles do not carry over to the Electron build. Please add your ZoneMinder server again from the **Profiles** page.

Sorry for the inconvenience. Web, iOS, and Android builds are unaffected.

For background see [#150](https://github.com/ZoneMinder/zmNinjaNg/issues/150).

title: Developer Notice channel is live
body:
Hi! This is the new in-app channel for short notes from the developer. You'll see a pulsing dot in the sidebar next to **Developer Notice** when there's something new. Click the row to read; the dot goes away once you do.

Features supported in notice bodies:

- **Bold**, *italic*, and `inline code`
- Bullet lists
- [Links](https://github.com/ZoneMinder/zmNinjaNg) that open in a new tab

Critical notices (security advisories, urgent action) also surface as a banner at the top of the app until dismissed.
